topic: Active Conversations & Sentence Structure (SVO vs SOV)
learning_objective: Practice interactive conversational responses and switch smoothly from Afaan Oromoo SOV (Subject-Object-Verb) word order to English SVO (Subject-Verb-Object) while accurately using pronouns He/She/They.
afaan_oromoo_intro_script: Sadarkaa 3ffaatti baga nagaan dhuftan! Afaan Oromoo keessatti gochimni dhuma himaa irratti dhufa (Fkn: 'Inni kitaaba dubbisa'). Ingiliffa keessatti garuu gochimni gidduu gala: 'He reads a book'. Kana shaakallaa!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Caaltuun maal gochaa jirti? Ingiliffaan 'Isheen kitaaba dubbisa' jechuuf: 'She reads a book' jedhii deebisi.

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Hubadhu: 'She a book reads' hin jedhinaa! Gochima (reads) gidduu kaa'i: 'She reads a book'!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: 'Isaan' jechuuf 'They' fayyadami. Arraba ilkaan jala kaa'ii 'They' jedhi.

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: 'Dei' hin jedhin, kokkeen akka hollatu 'They' jedhii arraba ilkaan gidduu baasi.

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Qotee bulaan eessa deemaa jira? Deebii kenni: 'He walks to the market.'

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Hidhii kee akka geengoo godhii 'Walks' jedhi, akka /v/ hin ta'in.
